---
title: "Limits"
description: "How many deployments and deploys a team can have on Cursor-managed hosting, and the error a deploy returns at the cap."
---

# Limits

Cursor caps deployments for every team. These are the default values.

| Limit | Default | What counts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `owner.deployments` | 20 | Each installed slug, including a stopped slug. An uninstalled slug counts when a build from the last 2 hours is still in progress or has finished successfully. |
| `owner.deploysPerDay` | 100 | Each accepted deploy in a rolling 24-hour window, including a redeploy. |

The error looks like this:

```json
{
  "error": "Your team has 20 of 20 deployments. Delete one with `agent-sdk deployment delete <slug>`, or contact support to raise the limit. Redeploying an existing slug doesn't count.",
  "code": "limit_exceeded",
  "limit": "owner.deployments",
  "max": 20,
  "current": 20,
  "docsUrl": "https://cursor.com/docs/agent-sdk/reference/limits"
}
```

To free a slot, run `agent-sdk deployment delete <slug>`, or wait until the
oldest counted deploy is 24 hours old. A deploy can also answer `503` with a
`Retry-After` header, and you can retry it after that many seconds.
